articles.title: A Flick of Magic Wins the FA Cup!
articles.summary: Antoine Semenyo scored an amazing back-flick goal to give Manchester City a 1-0 win over Chelsea in the FA Cup final. City now has two trophies this season and still hopes for a Premier League miracle.

articles.title: No Trains! New York Commuter Strike Shuts Down the LIRR
articles.summary: Union workers for the Long Island Rail Road went on strike Saturday, shutting down the biggest commuter rail in North America. About 250,000 weekday riders now have to find other ways to get to New York City.

articles.title: Colleges Want Rural Kids — But Will They Go?
articles.summary: Top colleges like Amherst are trying harder to recruit students from small towns. A program called STARS has helped 90,000 rural students apply, but many still worry about fitting in, cost, and leaving home.
